description: This Java source file defines a RecyclerView ViewHolder class 'MenuViewHolder' used for managing individual menu items in an Android application's navigation menu. It handles binding menu data to UI elements and applying branding styling.

classes.name: MenuViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder for navigation menu items in the Android app, responsible for binding data and applying styling.

methods.name: MenuViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view holder with data binding.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a MenuItem to the view, sets icon, label, visibility of count, click listener, and applies branding styles.
